title: Live, Love, LASSO
body: Suppose we want to fit an OLS model with $$p$$ features and an intercept. Call this Model A. For each proposed change to Model A in the table below, select all possible effects on four measures: (model bias)2 , model variance, MSE on the training data, and MSE on held-out test data. For each box, select Increase, Decrease, or both. At least one option will always apply. For each box, the effect(s) you select do not have to be guaranteed, they just have to be possible. For each row, you should assume there are no changes to the model except for the proposed change. You should assume that the data-generating process does not change, and that the model fitting process always converges.You do not have to consider whether the proposed change has no effect on the measure, though it may be possible.\n##figure1.gif
